resource.title: [Jules Task 15] Whole-Solution BOQ Integration & Nuance Gap Suite
resource.prompt:
Create a comprehensive integration test suite in tests/test_whole_solution_integration_gaps.js to stress-test and audit all nuance gaps in end-to-end BOQ interactions:
1. Input / Output Variety: Test evaluation with various raw inputs (multi-line CSV, raw text, Excel quotes, mixed uppercase/lowercase SKUs, trailing whitespace, and comments).
2. Whole-Configuration Grounding & Manifests: Test formatNotebookQueryPayload and executeNotebookQuery with whole-solution BOM manifests across multi-node clusters (e.g. 10x DB servers + 5x App nodes).
3. Strategy Matrix Consistency: Validate that 5-tier ranked solutions (Rank 1 to Rank 5) maintain logical CapEx relationships and contain zero duplicate ranks or unbuildable SKUs.
4. Offline vs Live Fallback Nuances: Verify that evaluateBOQMultiAspect gracefully handles missing credentials with high-confidence Local RAG fallbacks without crashing.
Ensure all tests pass and integrate into npm run test:all.

- Handling offline environment degradation ensuring gracefull RAG fallback.

Also included the new test suite sequentially in the test:all npm script chain to execute as part of standard CI runs.
